pdfUnsupported.en: PDF export is not supported on this platform

fileTooBig.en: The file is too big to open here.

notDocument.en: It isn't a document Textus can read.

wordOnly.en: Only Word documents (.docx) can be opened this way.

moveIntoItself.en: A folder can't move into itself.

trashShownFolder.en: The folder the tree shows can't be moved to the Trash.

pluginBadPackage.en: The package names a file outside itself.

catalogNewer.en: The plugin catalog is for a newer Textus - update Textus to see it.

imageTooBig.en: The image is empty or exceeds the 25 MB limit.

pictureTooLarge.en: That picture is too large to send, even made smaller.

pictureFormat.en: Textus can't read HEIC or AVIF pictures on this system yet. Save it as JPEG or PNG and attach that.

archiveTooLarge.en: That archive is too large to unpack.

secretsFile.en: This file holds Textus's keys; it isn't opened here.

httpsOnly.en: Only an https:// page opens in a tab.

imageServiceTimeout.en: The image service didn't send the picture in time.

skillName.en: That skill's name can't be used as a file name.

skillTooLong.en: That skill is too long to save.

notSkill.en: That isn't a skill file: it needs a name and instructions.

skillNoMode.en: A skill needs at least one mode.

tooBroad.en: This folder is too broad to open (your home folder or a whole drive). Choose a more specific folder.

noProject.en: Save this document first - the AI works in its folder.

noSamples.en: None of the picked files could be read as text.

notRemembered.en: That file isn't one Textus AI remembered.

unknownBuiltin.en: This version has no built-in skill by that name.

notACopy.en: This skill is your own, not a copy of the built-in, so there's nothing to reset.

skillExists.en: A skill of that name is already there.

sendLimit.en: You've sent several reports today. Try again tomorrow, or submit it on GitHub.
